operation.description:
Lists repositories and their GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization.
The data fetched using this API is refreshed approximately every 5 minutes, so values returned from this endpoint may take at least 5 minutes to get updated.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: List repositories with GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-usage.description: GitHub Actions Cache Usage by repository.

active_caches_count.description: The number of active caches in the repository.

active_caches_size_in_bytes.description: The sum of the size in bytes of all the active cache items in the repository.

full_name.description: The repository owner and name for the cache usage being shown.

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-usage.title: Actions Cache Usage by repository
